testimonials.name: Shrivatsa Kulkarni
testimonials.review: I had a very good experience at this dental clinic. The doctors and staff were very professional, friendly, and made me feel at ease throughout the entire process.

testimonials.name: Sindhu Bhagi
testimonials.review: My daughter is 7 years old and the doctor Bhargavi is patient and makes her feel comfortable. She did not suggest unnecessary and expensive treatments. It was a wonderful experience.

testimonials.name: Srihari Upadhyaya K
testimonials.review: A good dental clinic that offers great value for money. Dr. Bhargavi Koty did an excellent job with my root canal treatment and cap fitting — she explained the procedure clearly and gave proper post-treatment instructions.
